slot.brief: Which statement about ozone-depleting substances / mechanism of Cl radical catalysed ozone decomposition is correct; simple fact-check statements.

stem: Which statement correctly describes chlorine-radical-catalysed ozone depletion?
options: CFCs release chlorine radicals mainly by reaction with water vapour in the troposphere.
A chlorine radical is permanently consumed after reacting with an ozone molecule.
A chlorine radical is regenerated, and the net reaction is $\text{O}_3+\text{O}\rightarrow2\text{O}_2$.
CFCs initiate ozone depletion by photolysis with visible light.

verdicts.working: Cl· reacts with O₃ to form ClO· and O₂; ClO· then reacts with O to regenerate Cl· and produce another O₂. Net: O₃ + O → 2O₂.

working:
$\text{Cl}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_3\rightarrow\text{ClO}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_2$
$\text{ClO}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}\rightarrow\text{Cl}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_2$
Net: $\text{O}_3+\text{O}\rightarrow2\text{O}_2$; $\text{Cl}\boldsymbol{\cdot}$ is regenerated.

Independent check: Cl· reacts with O₃ to form ClO· and O₂; ClO· then reacts with O to regenerate Cl· and produce another O₂. Net: O₃ + O → 2O₂.
solution:
Chlorine radicals catalyse ozone depletion through the steps
$$\text{Cl}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_3\rightarrow\text{ClO}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_2,\qquad \text{ClO}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}\rightarrow\text{Cl}\boldsymbol{\cdot}+\text{O}_2.$$
The chlorine radical is regenerated; the net reaction is $\text{O}_3+\text{O}\rightarrow2\text{O}_2$.

draft.distractor_notes: A: CFCs release chlorine radicals through ultraviolet photolysis, not mainly by tropospheric reaction with water. B: The chlorine radical is regenerated in the catalytic cycle. C: CFC photolysis is driven by ultraviolet, not visible, light.
